parameter.name: cacheSize
parameter.description: Duration of the object cache, effectively used for origins.

parameter.name: maximumDistance
parameter.description: The maximum station distance in degrees.

parameter.name: minimumStations
parameter.description: The minimum number of stations required to compute and populate the goodness of fit.

parameter.name: updateInverval
parameter.description: The update interval in seconds to check for OGF updates.

parameter.name: preArrivalTimeWindow
parameter.description: An offset in seconds that will be substracted from the arrival time to compute the desired envelope time window.

parameter.name: postArrivalTimeShare
parameter.description: "the event is over" (event as represented by an origin) - defined as multiple of the s travel time between an origin and the furthest considered station.

parameter.name: predictionArchivePath
parameter.description: The path of the predicted envelopes and ground motion coefficients.

parameter.name: commentID
parameter.description: The ID of the comment of the evaluated origin which receives the maximum of the computed GOF values for each magnitude.

parameter.name: commentMagID
parameter.description: The ID of the comment of the evaluated origin which receives the magnitude type of the maximum GOF value.

parameter.name: tableType
parameter.description: Type of travel-time interface. Also consider "tableModel"!

parameter.name: table
parameter.description: The travel-time model to be used. The availability of models depends on "tableType"

parameter.name: tableAllowNegativeDepths
parameter.description: Indicates whether the travel-time model supports events with negative depths. If false, negative event depths are queried as depth 0. If true, the travel-time model is queried using the event's actual depth, including negative depths.

parameter.name: bufferSize
parameter.description: The buffer size of the envelope buffer per sensor location. This value represents the number of items in the buffer. If the envelope computation is based on an interval of 1s then this value corresponds to number of seconds.

parameter.name: maxDelay
parameter.description: The maximum envelope delay in seconds to accept after the event lifetime is over.

group.name: envelopeMagnitude
group.description: This groups controls the computation of the envelope magnitude for each processed origin. The envelope magnitude is expressed as the maximum GOF computed over a magnitude interval with a defined spacing.

parameter.name: enable
parameter.description: Enable flag.

parameter.name: type
parameter.description: The type of the envelope magnitude.

parameter.name: minimum
parameter.description: The minimum of the magnitude interval.

parameter.name: maximum
parameter.description: The maximum of the magnitude interval.

parameter.name: spacing
parameter.description: The spacing of the magnitude interval.

parameter.name: include
parameter.description: Sensor location IDs to accept. Empty means all.

parameter.name: exclude
parameter.description: Sensor location IDs to reject. Empty means none.

parameter.name: defaultSoilClass
parameter.description: The default sensor location soil class.

option.description: The RecordStream source URL. Format: [service://]location[#type]. 'service' is the name of the RecordStream driver. If 'service' is not given, 'file://' is being used and the name of a miniSEED file can be given. This parameter is only required when reading pre-calculated envelope values in offline processing, see --ep and --origin-id.

Name of input XML file (SCML) with all origin for offline processing. Use '-' to read from stdin. The database connection is not received from messaging and must be provided. Results will be written as XML to stdout. Please note that envelope data must be provided with -I.
Use formatted XML output. Otherwise XML is unformatted.
Dump results as XML rather than sending messages.
